snippet.title: Psalm 78: This is the Future of the Church
snippet.description: Psalm 78 is a call for us to invest in the future of the Church: our children. Reaching the next generation is one of the most important ways to ensure the Church will continue to grow and for the Gospel to advance. But we also need to recognize this isn’t just about biological age! Many are spiritual children and need spiritual fathers and mothers to help them grow.
